summary: Read current identity for every browser send-grant observation

replay.detail: Unknown attempts remain non-retryable; no automatic replay is added.

schema.detail: No browser or server storage schema changes.

compatibility.detail: The initial SDK probe is reused only by the readiness barrier. Every send-grant observation, including the first composer mount, reads current capabilities and initializes the corresponding outbox scope. Startup without a composer retains one capabilities read.

recovery.detail: A scope observed through recovery discovery or reconnect is not replaced by a cached startup identity when a composer first mounts. Original persisted scope tuples remain immutable.
